- SAP deviation: no multilevel model; the export supports only descriptive classification.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

source(here("R", "chip.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Classification

```{r}
#| label: chip-classification

alterations <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-alterations.parquet")
)
samples <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
)

valid_mutations <- alterations |>
  filter(alteration_type == "mutation", valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    chip_classification = classify_chip_status(
      alteration_type,
      found_in_solid_biopsy,
      found_in_buffy_coat
    )
  )

# Table order and labels; the report matches these labels exactly.
class_labels <- c(
  definite_chip = "CHIP: buffy-coat positive, solid-biopsy negative",
  definite_non_chip = "Non-CHIP: buffy-coat negative",
  tissue_positive_buffy_missing =
    "Non-CHIP: solid-biopsy positive, buffy-coat sequencing missing",
  possible_germline = "Possible germline: positive in tissue and buffy coat",
  ctdna_only_unknown =
    "Uncertain: ctDNA-only, buffy-coat sequencing missing",
  unresolved = "Unresolved: other missing evidence"
)

valid_records <- nrow(valid_mutations)

chip_status_summary <- valid_mutations |>
  mutate(
    chip_classification = factor(
      chip_classification,
      levels = names(class_labels)
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(chip_classification, .drop = FALSE) |>
  summarise(
    mutation_records = n(),
    unique_variants = n_distinct(variant_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    patients = n_distinct(id, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    classification = unname(class_labels[as.character(chip_classification)]),
    percent_of_valid_mutations = if (valid_records == 0L) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      100 * mutation_records / valid_records
    },
    valid_mutation_records = valid_records
  ) |>
  select(
    classification,
    mutation_records,
    unique_variants,
    patients,
    percent_of_valid_mutations,
    valid_mutation_records
  )
```

## CHIP proportion under two assumptions

```{r}
#| label: chip-assumptions

eligible_mutations <- valid_mutations |>
  filter(
    chip_classification %in% c(
      "definite_chip",
      "definite_non_chip",
      "tissue_positive_buffy_missing",
      "ctdna_only_unknown"
    )
  )

valid_ctdna_patients <- samples |>
  filter(valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE, !is.na(id)) |>
  pull(id) |>
  n_distinct()

# Classes counted as CHIP under each assumption; the report matches the
# assumption labels exactly.
chip_classes <- list(
  "Assume ctDNA-only unknowns are not CHIP" = "definite_chip",
  "Assume ctDNA-only unknowns are CHIP" = c(
    "definite_chip",
    "ctdna_only_unknown"
  )
)

chip_assumption_summary <- imap(chip_classes, \(classes, assumption) {
  chip_rows <- eligible_mutations |>
    filter(chip_classification %in% classes)

  tibble(
    assumption = assumption,
    chip_mutations = nrow(chip_rows),
    assumption_eligible_mutation_records = nrow(eligible_mutations),
    chip_mutation_percent = if_else(
      nrow(eligible_mutations) == 0L,
      NA_real_,
      100 * nrow(chip_rows) / nrow(eligible_mutations)
    ),
    patients_with_chip_mutation = n_distinct(chip_rows$id, na.rm = TRUE),
    valid_ctdna_patients = valid_ctdna_patients,
    patients_with_chip_percent = if_else(
      valid_ctdna_patients == 0L,
      NA_real_,
      100 * patients_with_chip_mutation / valid_ctdna_patients
    )
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(
  chip_status_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "chip-status-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  chip_assumption_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "chip-assumption-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: chip-status-table
#| tbl-cap: "ctDNA mutation classification using solid-biopsy and buffy-coat findings"
#| echo: false

chip_status_summary |>
  select(
    classification,
    mutation_records,
    percent_of_valid_mutations,
    unique_variants,
    patients
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: chip-assumption-table
#| tbl-cap: "Proportion of valid ctDNA mutations classified as CHIP under two assumptions"
#| echo: false

chip_assumption_summary |>
  select(
    assumption,
    chip_mutations,
    assumption_eligible_mutation_records,
    chip_mutation_percent,
    patients_with_chip_mutation,
    valid_ctdna_patients,
    patients_with_chip_percent
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 1)
```
